Game Overview

Fall Jack puts players into a puzzle experience centered on guide a cheerful Jack-o'-lantern through a spine-chilling world where strategic landings mean survival. With each precise move, navigate rotating spooky settings, dodging eerie creatures and collecting charming treasures. Embrace the haunting ambiance and plan ahead to conquer dynamically challenging environments in this captivating Halloween puzzle adventure.
